persist-project-key.reason: Implemented project_key override on the live overdeck.db conversations module (src/lib/overdeck/conversations.ts), not the dead-code src/lib/database/conversations-db.ts the xBRIEF named -- that module has zero production importers, the live path is conversation-runtime.ts/conversation-list.ts through overdeck/conversations.ts. Added Drizzle column, LegacyConversation/-Row + SELECT + mapper, setConversationProjectKey setter, idempotent runtime top-up + drift-audit sentinel, fresh-DB init migration, and unit tests (default-null/set/overwrite/clear-to-null). projectKey flows to GET /api/conversations via existing enrichConversationList spread. Commits a10f31d, be9cf7d (file-size allowlist bump).

moved-event.reason: Added conversation.moved event to packages/contracts/src/events.ts (Schema.Struct mirroring conversation.created, added to DomainEvent union) and a reducer case in event-reducers.ts bumping conversationsListRevision. Contracts build clean, full typecheck + lint pass with no new errors. Commit c295eaf.

move-endpoint.reason: Added PATCH /api/conversations/:name/move. Logic lives in handleConversationMove (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-reads.ts), mirroring patchConversationTitle; route in conversations.ts just delegates. Covers all 5 ACs: 200+updated conv, 404 unknown conv, 400 'Unknown project: <key>' for both unregistered-key and missing-path cases, 200 no-op+no-emit when already in target project, conversation.moved emitted with {conversationName,projectKey} on real moves, and a dedicated test asserting cwd + claudeSessionId (JSONL pointer) unchanged after move. 7 new tests pass, full typecheck/lint clean, file-size allowlist bumped for routes/conversations.ts (1004->1029, over the 1000 ceiling). Commit 6d0b238.

frontend-grouping-foundation.reason: Conversation type gains projectKey (ConversationList.tsx). isUnscopedConversation, resolveConversationProjectName, and the projectConversations bucketing loop in CommandDeck/index.tsx all check the override first, falling back to cwd inference only when null -- unit-tested precedence (5 new tests in projectsData.test.ts covering override-wins, override-set-but-unmatched=unscoped, null-falls-back-to-cwd, no-match, neither-set). ac2 (live re-group on conversation.moved) was already satisfied by the moved-event item's reducer case bumping conversationsListRevision, which ConversationList's existing effect already invalidates the ['conversations'] query on. Full frontend typecheck/lint clean, 458 CommandDeck tests + 14 Sidebar tests pass with no regressions. File-size allowlist bumped for CommandDeck/index.tsx (1597->1618). Commit 2c30e8d.

cli-move.reason: Added pan conversations move <query> <projectKey>. Resolver: exact getConversationByName first, then unique fuzzy title match over listConversations(); non-zero exit with clear message for no-match or ambiguous match (lists candidates). PATCHes the move endpoint via getDashboardApiUrlSync, prints resolved title + old->new project labels (via getProjectSync name lookup), handles ECONNREFUSED as 'Dashboard not running'. Follows show.ts/reset-review.ts chalk+exitCli conventions. 8 new tests (exact match, fuzzy match, success labels, no-match, ambiguous, unknown-project, dashboard-down, command registration) all pass; typecheck/lint clean. Commit ccca029.

move-mutation.reason: Added move({name, projectKey, projectName}) to useConversationMutations following the favoriteMutation pattern: onMutate cancels+optimistically patches projectKey in the ['conversations'] cache (captures title before the patch for the success toast, matching AC's 'title not id' requirement); onError rolls back from context + toast.error(server message); onSuccess toast.success('Moved <title> to <project>'); onSettled invalidates. 4 new tests: optimistic-apply, rollback-on-error, title-based success toast, settle-invalidation. Full CommandDeck suite (462 tests) passes with no regressions, typecheck/lint clean.

cli-skill.reason: Created sync-sources/skills/pan-conversations/SKILL.md documenting all 9 subcommands (scan/search/list/show/jsonl/move/current/cost/embed/enrich) matching --help output exactly. Adding 'move' to the CLI in the prior commit had drifted packages/contracts/src/composer-commands.generated.ts (caught by lint:slash-commands under full npm run lint); regenerated via npm run generate:slash-commands and included here. scripts/lint-skills.sh and full npm run lint pass clean. Commit 5abf57e2.

menu-move.reason: Added Move item + project-picker submenu to ConversationRow's 3-dot/right-click menu (the actual per-row menu; discovered ConversationActionMenu.tsx is NOT shared with it as the xBRIEF assumed -- it's only used by the Stage pane-tab context menu, so added Move there too for consistency). Current project (conversation.projectKey) is indicated+disabled in the picker; selecting another calls mutations.move. Registered-projects lifted to ConversationList level and passed as a prop (avoids N duplicate per-row fetches; fixed a pre-existing fetch-count test by pre-seeding the query in the shared test client helper). 4 new tests (3-dot picker, right-click picker, current-project disabled, mutation fires on select); full CommandDeck suite (466 tests) passes; typecheck/lint clean. Commit d520d87.
